commands.command: as my health reaches zero, the chill of the larder seeps into my bones one last time. i set down the blue gourd, its shape stark against the stone floor, and feel consciousness slip away like water through cupped hands. the season ends, as all things must.
the game ends as your health reaches 0. you die in the cold larder.
lately you have: go north; go east; go yard; go south; go hall; go west; go yard; go east.
your world fades to black... you have died.
we have died. the season ends. we are no more.
